messages:
tessa_sales: Heads-up — SpruceAI is asking for a custom concession. They say we charged marketplace integration fees twice and are asking for a one-time credit plus flexible payment terms while they reconcile with procurement. Can finance approve?
oliver_finance: How much are they requesting and is this a billing error or customer-side duplicate charge?
billing-bot: Retrieved invoice INV-2026-2099:
```
Line 1: Dedicated Pool 10 GPUs x 720h = $60,000
Line 2: Marketplace integration (setup) = $4,500
Line 3: Marketplace integration (duplicate) = $4,500
Tax: $1,800
Total: $70,800
```
tessa_sales: They want the full $4,500 credit for the duplicate integration line and asked to move next invoice to Net60 for one cycle.
manu_revops: FYI credits >$3k start to impact MRR recognition and comp calculations. Anything >$5k needs director/VP sign-off. I'll create comp ops ticket CO-4128 regardless.
lara_legal: Legal ok with one-time credit; need acknowledgement language that it's non-recurring and final. If extending payment terms, prefer Net45 unless AR signs off to Net60.
ben_fpna: Finance discretionary limit is $5k for managers. $4,500 is within that. Net60 affects DSO; AR must accept. I can approve the $4,500 credit and Net45. If sales insists on Net60, escalate to AR.
tessa_sales: SpruceAI specifically asked for Net60 and said procurement needs extra time due to PO consolidation. Can we compromise: $4,500 credit + Net45 and offer Net60 if AR confirms? I'll ask them to accept Net45.
manu_revops: Created CO-4128 — notes: SpruceAI duplicate integration charge $4,500; comp ops to review if commission was paid on that amount.
billing-bot: Preparing credit memo CM-2026-229 for $4,500 pending customer_ack_spruce_2026-04-12.eml. Will apply after ack and AR confirmation for any Net60 exception.
ben_fpna: Approved (internal): $4,500 credit + Net45 for next invoice. Document decision in Deal Desk entry DDK-2026-257. Attach signed customer ack when received.
tessa_sales: Sent acknowledgement wording with legal text; customer signed and accepted Net45. Uploading to Deal Desk now.
billing-bot: CM-2026-229 created and queued; applying to INV-2026-2099 on receipt of customer_ack_spruce_2026-04-12.eml.
lara_legal: Pasting required sentence for ack: "This one-time credit of $4,500 resolves the billing dispute in full and is non-precedential."
tessa_sales: SpruceAI signed and returned the ack. Will update the Deal Desk entry and close the loop. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
